subject: West Lake Product Launch — advance funding & petty cash reconciliation
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.m@sageevents.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: West Lake launch — quick cost breakdown and deposit ask

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the site walk yesterday. Per our conversation, can you confirm the final line items so I can route the advance? Our current numbers:
- Venue rental (single-day block, 8am–9pm): $45,000
- AV package (staging, two microphones, livestream encoder): $8,200
- Catering (lunch + coffee service for 220): $12,500
- On-site staffing (security, check-in): $2,000

Subtotal: $67,700
Requested advance to secure the space and AV hold: $34,000 (50% of venue + 100% AV hold).
Day-of petty cash recommended: $1,500 (taxi reimbursements & miscellaneous vendor tips).

Please attach W9 and insurance certificate so finance can create the PO. Also attaching the site plan for reference.

Thanks,
Priya
Event Lead — Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sage_Siteplan.pdf (see attached)
From: Elena Morales <elena.m@sageevents.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: West Lake launch — quick cost breakdown and deposit ask

Hi Priya,

Confirming the figures below — I rounded catering up to account for dietary requests. W9 and COI attached.
- Venue rental: $45,000 (US$)
- AV package: $8,200
- Catering: $12,500
- On-site staffing: $2,000
- Estimated additional rigging (if required): $0–$1,200 (we'll confirm during load-in)

We can accept a 50% venue deposit and full AV hold to reserve your date. W9_SageEvents.pdf and COI_SageEvents.pdf attached (COI referenced in file list). Let me know the PO number and any specific invoice remit instructions for accounts-payable.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director, Sales — Sage Events

Attachments: W9_SageEvents.pdf (attachment), COI_SageEvents.pdf (attachment)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: West Lake launch — quick cost breakdown and deposit ask

Thanks Priya/Elena — quick finance checklist so we can move the advance: 
1) Vendor tax docs: W9 received — good.
2) COI: need policy limits on GL and WC (Elena, can you confirm insurer limits match Redwood's min requirements: $1M GL, $1M WC?).
3) Cost center and GL mapping from events: please confirm cost center and ledger code. For now I will tentatively map to CC 4202–FIELD-MKT and GL 6310 (Event Services).
4) Requested PO/advance: please confirm exact advance amount. We will only approve full vendor pre-pay if contract is signed. Otherwise a 50% deposit is standard.

Priya — if you confirm cost center and whether the MSA signature is complete, I'll draft PO and route for approvals. Also need to know if petty cash will be reconciled via Concur or through a central fund (we prefer Concur for receipts).

Rishi
Finance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Elena Morales <elena.m@sageevents.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: West Lake launch — quick cost breakdown and deposit ask

Rishi — confirming the details: 
- Final advance requested: $34,100 (includes $100 buffer for small adjustments).
- Cost center: 4202–FIELD-MKT
- GL code: 6310
- MSA status: signed by Sage on 2026-09-25; I have the signed copy (Signed_MSA.pdf) and uploaded it to EVENT-412 in Jira.
- Petty cash: prefer to issue a $1,500 petty cash advance to on-site manager and reconcile via Concur with itemized receipts.

Marissa — you are listed as the on-site manager for reconciliation. Please confirm you can collect receipts and submit by 10/12.

Priya
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, accounts-payable@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2026-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: PO draft and remit info — PO-2026-0897

Team,

I've created PO-2026-0897 for Sage Events. Summary: 
- PO total: $67,700
- Advance (50% venue + 100% AV): $34,100 (as requested)
- Petty cash handled separately via Concur: $1,500 advance to event lead (marissa_cole).

Remit details for Sage per their W9: payables@sageevents.com — please cc accountspayable@redwood.com on invoices. I also attached the PO PDF for records. Elena — please confirm the invoice number format you will use so AP can match.

Next steps:
- Priya/Marissa: acknowledge petty cash workflow and that receipts will be uploaded to Concur by 10/12.
- Elena: confirm insurer limits on the COI (re: Rishi's note).

Rishi
Finance Manager

Attachments: PO-2026-0897.pdf (attachment)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Also confirming insurer limits looked fine on the COI Elena provided (1M GL / 1M WC).

Thanks everyone — moving to PO payment routing.

Marissa
